activity.overview: Trace a current public issue to its roots in the history we studied this semester, weigh the options, deliberate with classmates, and propose a specific action.
activity.prompt: Choose a current public issue in your community or the nation that has roots in this course, for example worker pay and unions, food and product safety, voting access, free speech and surveillance during national emergencies, or equal access to schools. Write a civic proposal addressed to a specific official or body. Pose a compelling question about the issue. Explain its history, using evidence from at least one unit of this course and at least two current, authoritative sources. Evaluate at least two options for action, including their intended and unintended consequences and who would bear their costs. Recommend one, describe the action you will take (a letter, public comment, or presentation), and summarize what your deliberation group agreed and disagreed on.

activity.title: Take Informed Action
